highlights.headline: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
highlights.summary: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, students in many cities are set to protest against military conscription. DW has the latest.

items.title: India news: Protests against election chief escalate as Gandhi, Cockroach party allege 'rigged' vote
items.description: Police have used tear gas on protests by the opposition Congress party demanding India's election commission head steps down, following a report alleging "rigged" elections. DW has more.

items.title: ‘Robust little’ vessel begins treacherous 22,000km journey around Antarctica in the name of climate science

items.title: US backs Elon Musk's bid to overturn €120m EU fine against X

items.title: Bundesliga and three other top European leagues call for major FIFA reforms
items.description: The Bundesliga and three other leading European football leagues have called for major reforms to the world-governing body FIFA. However, they stopped short of calling for FIFA boss Gianni Infantino's resignation.
